---
# =====================================================================
# FACILITATOR GUIDE TEMPLATE
# =====================================================================
#
# HOW TO EDIT THIS FILE (no coding experience needed)
#
#  1. Save a copy first. Name it facilitator.qmd and put it in the
#     lesson's folder. Never edit the original template.
#
#  2. Fill in the blanks. Every blank looks like {{SOMETHING}}.
#     Select the whole thing, including both sets of curly braces,
#     and type your text over it. Tip: use Find (Ctrl+F / Cmd+F)
#     and search for {{ to jump from blank to blank.
#
#  3. Leave the "structure" lines alone. Lines that start with :::
#     open and close boxes, and they always come in pairs. Don't
#     edit or delete one by itself. Also leave alone anything inside
#     { } that comes right after a ] or ), such as {.fg-btn}.
#
#  4. Gray notes between <!-- and --> are instructions for you.
#     They never show on the web page. You can leave them in.
#
#  5. To ADD another item (a card, panel, step, slide...):
#     find its "COPY START" line, select everything from that line
#     down to the matching "COPY END" line (including both lines),
#     copy it, and paste it on a new line right after the COPY END.
#
#  6. To REMOVE an item: delete everything from its COPY START line
#     down to its COPY END line (including both lines).
#     To remove a whole section: delete from its "SECTION START"
#     note down to its "SECTION END" note.
#
#  7. Don't edit anything below the line that says
#     "STOP. DO NOT EDIT ANYTHING BELOW THIS LINE."
#
#  8. To see your changes, click "Preview" (Positron or RStudio)
#     or run: quarto preview facilitator.qmd
#     If the page looks broken, undo (Ctrl+Z / Cmd+Z) your last
#     change. The usual cause is a deleted ::: line.
#
#  9. Educative features (extra supports for teachers) are ready-to-copy
#     files in the folder _educative-features. Open the file, select
#     all, copy, and paste it where you want it in this file. What goes
#     in each feature is explained in educative-features-guide.qmd.
#
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# For maintainers: the page only matches the AAIC site when rendered
# inside modules/<module>/<lesson>/ of the app-ai-corps/web repo,
# whose _quarto.yml supplies the theme, fonts and
# link-external-newwindow (external links open in a new tab).
# =====================================================================
title: "Facilitator's Guide:<br>{{LESSON_TITLE}}"
subtitle: "{{MODULE_NAME}} · Lesson {{LESSON_NUMBER}}"
format:
  live-html:
    toc: true
    toc-location: right
    toc-title: "On this page"
    toc-depth: 2
    page-layout: article
    smooth-scroll: true
---

```{=html}
<!-- =================================================================
     STYLES AND SCRIPT — for whoever maintains the template.
     Uses the AAIC brand palette. Edit the --aaic-* values to rebrand.
     ================================================================= -->
<style>
  /* AAIC palette — same values as styles-main.css on the main site.
     custom-module-theme.scss (loaded by the water-quality _quarto.yml)
     already handles fonts, link colors, TOC/sidebar hover, navbar,
     and callout borders, so this block only styles the new components. */
  :root {
    --aaic-globe: #006C93;      /* primary: links, accents */
    --aaic-torch: #E65933;      /* hover / active (theme uses #e65933) */
    --aaic-valley: #00746F;
    --aaic-river: #517C96;
    --aaic-orange: #FF8200;     /* Tennessee orange */
    --aaic-sunsphere: #FED535;
    --aaic-smokey: #58595B;
    --aaic-limestone: #F0EDE3;
    --aaic-summit: #B9E1E2;
    --aaic-ltblue: #f1f9f9;     /* .ltblue-container / .checkpoint-box */
    --aaic-ltorange: #fdf5f2;   /* .dkorange-container */
    --aaic-border: #dcdcdc;
    --fg-accent: var(--aaic-globe);
    --fg-radius: 12px;          /* matches .module-card */
    --fg-heading-font: 'Montserrat', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
  }

  /* Buttons — pill shape like the main-site .btn, sized for cards.
     Use .fg-btn (solid) or .fg-btn-outline. */
  .fg-btn, .fg-btn-outline {
    display: inline-block;
    border-radius: 50px;
    border: 2px solid var(--aaic-globe);
    padding: 0.35rem 1.1rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    text-decoration: none !important;
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
  }
  .fg-btn { background: var(--aaic-globe); color: #fff !important; }
  .fg-btn-outline { background: #fff; color: var(--aaic-globe) !important; }
  .fg-btn:hover, .fg-btn-outline:hover {
    background: var(--aaic-torch);
    border-color: var(--aaic-torch);
    color: #fff !important;
    transform: translateY(-1px);
  }

  /* Small tags (badges) */
  .fg-tag {
    display: inline-block;
    border-radius: 50px;
    padding: 0.15rem 0.6rem;
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    line-height: 1.4;
    vertical-align: middle;
    color: #fff;
    background: var(--aaic-smokey);
  }
  .fg-tag-globe  { background: var(--aaic-globe); }
  .fg-tag-valley { background: var(--aaic-valley); }
  .fg-tag-torch  { background: var(--aaic-torch); }
  .fg-tag-river  { background: var(--aaic-river); }
  .fg-tag-sun    { background: var(--aaic-sunsphere); color: #333; }
  .fg-tag-light  { background: var(--aaic-limestone); color: var(--aaic-globe); }

  /* Hero banner */
  .fg-hero {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--aaic-globe) 0%, var(--aaic-valley) 100%);
    color: #fff;
    border-radius: var(--fg-radius);
    padding: 1.75rem 2rem;
    margin: 1rem 0 1.5rem;
  }
  .fg-hero p { margin-bottom: 0.6rem; }
  .fg-hero .lead { font-size: 1.15rem; }
  .fg-hero .fg-tag { margin-right: 0.25rem; }
  .fg-hero .fg-btn { background: #fff; border-color: #fff; color: var(--aaic-globe) !important; }
  .fg-hero .fg-btn-outline { background: transparent; border-color: #fff; color: #fff !important; }
  .fg-hero .fg-btn:hover, .fg-hero .fg-btn-outline:hover {
    background: var(--aaic-orange); border-color: var(--aaic-orange); color: #fff !important;
  }

  /* Space below the at-a-glance row */

  /* Cards — share the main-site .module-card radius, shadow and hover */
  .fg-card, .fg-stat {
    border: 1px solid var(--aaic-border);
    border-radius: var(--fg-radius);
    box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06);
    height: 100%;
  }
  .fg-card { transition: all 0.3s ease; }
  .fg-card:hover {
    transform: translateY(-3px);
    box-shadow: 0 10px 25px rgba(0, 116, 111, 0.2);
    border-color: var(--aaic-torch);
  }
  .fg-card .card-body { display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
  .fg-card .card-body > p:last-child { margin-top: auto; margin-bottom: 0; }
  .fg-card .card-title {
    font-family: var(--fg-heading-font);
    font-weight: 700;
    color: var(--aaic-globe);
    margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
  }
  .fg-card .card-header {
    background: var(--aaic-ltblue);
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--aaic-border);
    font-family: var(--fg-heading-font);
    color: var(--aaic-globe);
    border-radius: var(--fg-radius) var(--fg-radius) 0 0;
  }

  /* Colored left edge for objective cards */
  .fg-edge { border-left: 5px solid var(--fg-edge-color, var(--fg-accent)) !important; }
  .fg-edge-globe  { --fg-edge-color: var(--aaic-globe); }
  .fg-edge-valley { --fg-edge-color: var(--aaic-valley); }
  .fg-edge-torch  { --fg-edge-color: var(--aaic-torch); }
  .fg-edge-river  { --fg-edge-color: var(--aaic-river); }

  /* Stat / at-a-glance cards */
  .fg-stat { text-align: center; background: var(--aaic-ltblue); }
  .fg-stat .fg-stat-icon { font-size: 1.6rem; line-height: 1; }
  .fg-stat .fg-stat-value {
    font-family: var(--fg-heading-font);
    font-size: 1.35rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--aaic-globe);
    margin: 0.35rem 0 0;
  }
  .fg-stat .fg-stat-label {
    font-size: 0.8rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em;
    color: var(--aaic-smokey); margin: 0;
  }

  /* Accordion */
  .accordion-item { border-color: var(--aaic-border); }
  .accordion-item:first-of-type { border-top-left-radius: var(--fg-radius); border-top-right-radius: var(--fg-radius); }
  .accordion-item:last-of-type  { border-bottom-left-radius: var(--fg-radius); border-bottom-right-radius: var(--fg-radius); }
  .accordion-header { margin: 0 !important; }
  /* Quarto appends a section-link icon to headings; inside an accordion
     header it wraps onto its own line, so hide it there */
  .accordion-header .anchorjs-link { display: none !important; }
  .accordion-button {
    font-family: var(--fg-heading-font);
    font-weight: 600;
    color: var(--aaic-globe);
  }
  .accordion-button:not(.collapsed) {
    background: var(--aaic-ltblue);
    color: var(--aaic-globe);
    box-shadow: inset 0 -1px 0 var(--aaic-border);
  }
  .accordion-button:hover { color: var(--aaic-torch); }
  .accordion-button:focus { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0.2rem rgba(0, 108, 147, 0.25); }

  /* Tabsets — Globe text, Torch underline on the active tab
     (the united theme would otherwise make them orange-red) */
  .panel-tabset .nav-tabs .nav-link { color: var(--aaic-globe); font-weight: 600; }
  /* Compact tabs so they fit on one row on wide screens; on narrower
     screens they wrap onto a second row (never a sideways scrollbar). */
  .panel-tabset .nav-tabs .nav-link { font-size: 0.8rem; padding: 0.4rem 0.55rem; white-space: nowrap; }
  .panel-tabset .nav-tabs .nav-link:hover { color: var(--aaic-torch); }
  .panel-tabset .nav-tabs .nav-link.active {
    color: var(--aaic-torch);
    border-bottom: 3px solid var(--aaic-torch);
  }

  /* Numbered prep steps */
  .fg-step {
    position: relative;
    border-left: 3px solid var(--aaic-summit);
    padding: 0.25rem 0 0.5rem 1.5rem;
    margin: 0 0 1.5rem 1rem;
  }
  .fg-step::before {
    content: counter(fgstep);
    position: absolute; left: -1rem; top: 0;
    width: 1.85rem; height: 1.85rem; border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--aaic-globe); color: #fff;
    font-family: var(--fg-heading-font);
    font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.9rem;
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  }
  .fg-step > h4:first-child, .fg-step > p:first-child { margin-top: 0; }
  .fg-step-meta { font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--aaic-smokey); }

  /* Lesson-flow timeline */
  .fg-timeline { list-style: none; padding-left: 0; margin: 1rem 0; }
  .fg-timeline > li {
    display: grid; grid-template-columns: 5.5rem 1fr; gap: 1rem;
    padding: 0.75rem 0; border-bottom: 1px dashed var(--aaic-border);
  }
  .fg-timeline > li:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
  .fg-timeline .fg-time {
    font-family: var(--fg-heading-font);
    font-weight: 700; color: var(--aaic-globe); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  }
  .fg-timeline .fg-time small { display: block; font-family: Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-weight: 400; color: var(--aaic-smokey); }
  .fg-timeline h5 { margin: 0 0 0.25rem; font-size: 1rem; }
  .fg-timeline p { margin: 0; }

  /* Carousel */
  .fg-carousel {
    border: 1px solid var(--aaic-border);
    border-radius: var(--fg-radius);
    overflow: hidden;
    background: var(--aaic-ltblue);
    margin: 1rem 0 1.5rem;
  }
  .fg-carousel .carousel-item img { max-height: 420px; object-fit: contain; margin: 0 auto; display: block; padding: 1rem 1rem 0; }
  .fg-carousel .fg-caption { padding: 0.75rem 3.5rem 2.5rem; text-align: center; }
  .fg-carousel .fg-caption strong { display: block; font-family: var(--fg-heading-font); color: var(--aaic-globe); }
  .fg-carousel .carousel-control-prev-icon,
  .fg-carousel .carousel-control-next-icon { filter: invert(1) grayscale(100); }
  .fg-carousel .carousel-indicators [data-bs-target] { background-color: var(--aaic-globe); }
  .fg-carousel figure { margin: 0; }

  /* Responsive video */
  .fg-video { border-radius: var(--fg-radius); overflow: hidden; margin: 1rem 0; }

  /* Link lists inside cards */
  .fg-card .list-group-item-action { color: var(--aaic-globe); }
  .fg-card .list-group-item-action:hover { color: var(--aaic-torch); background: var(--aaic-ltblue); }

  /* ---------- Educative features ---------- */
  .fg-ef-index { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.4rem; margin: 0.5rem 0 1.5rem; }
  .fg-ef-index a {
    display: inline-block; border: 1px solid var(--aaic-border); border-radius: 50px;
    padding: 0.2rem 0.7rem; font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 600;
    color: var(--aaic-globe); text-decoration: none; background: #fff;
  }
  .fg-ef-index a:hover { border-color: var(--aaic-torch); color: var(--aaic-torch); }
  .fg-ef-index a span { color: var(--aaic-smokey); font-weight: 400; margin-right: 0.25rem; }

  .fg-ef {
    border: 1px solid var(--aaic-border); border-radius: var(--fg-radius);
    padding: 1.25rem 1.5rem; margin: 0 0 1.5rem;
    box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04);
  }
  .fg-ef > h3:first-child, .fg-ef > section > h3 { margin-top: 0; }
  .fg-ef h3 { font-size: 1.2rem; color: var(--aaic-globe); margin-top: 0; }
  .fg-ef .fg-ef-meta { margin: -0.25rem 0 0.75rem; }

  /* "What goes here" — the papers' definition */
  .fg-ef-what {
    background: var(--aaic-ltblue); border-radius: 8px;
    padding: 0.75rem 1rem; margin-bottom: 1rem; font-size: 0.95rem;
  }
  .fg-ef-what > p:first-child::before {
    content: "What goes here"; display: block;
    font-family: var(--fg-heading-font); font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.75rem;
    text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; color: var(--aaic-globe);
    margin-bottom: 0.25rem;
  }
  .fg-ef-what p { margin-bottom: 0.4rem; }
  .fg-ef-what p:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }

  /* Example label above each component */
  .fg-ef-example-label {
    font-family: var(--fg-heading-font); font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.75rem;
    text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; color: var(--aaic-torch);
    margin: 0 0 0.4rem;
  }
  .fg-cite { font-size: 0.8rem; color: var(--aaic-smokey); white-space: nowrap; }
  .fg-ef-example-label .fg-cite { text-transform: none; letter-spacing: 0; font-weight: 400; font-family: Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; }

  /* Quoted example text */
  .fg-quote {
    border-left: 4px solid var(--aaic-summit); padding: 0.25rem 0 0.25rem 1rem;
    color: #333; font-style: italic; margin: 0.75rem 0;
  }
  .fg-quote p { margin-bottom: 0.4rem; }

  /* Core ideas map: before -> this unit -> later */
  .fg-flow { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1.3fr 1fr; gap: 1.75rem; align-items: stretch; }
  .fg-flow .fg-flow-step {
    border: 1px solid var(--aaic-border); border-radius: 8px; padding: 0.6rem 0.75rem;
    font-size: 0.9rem; background: #fff;
  }
  .fg-flow .fg-flow-step.fg-flow-now { border: 2px solid var(--aaic-globe); background: var(--aaic-ltblue); }
  .fg-flow .fg-flow-step strong { display: block; font-size: 0.75rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; color: var(--aaic-globe); }
  .fg-flow .fg-flow-arrow { align-self: center; color: var(--aaic-globe); font-size: 1.25rem; }
  @media (max-width: 640px) {
    .fg-flow { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    .fg-flow { gap: 2rem; }
  }

  /* Concept map placeholder */
  .fg-diagram {
    border: 2px dashed var(--aaic-summit); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--aaic-ltblue);
    padding: 1.5rem; text-align: center; color: var(--aaic-smokey); font-size: 0.9rem;
  }

  /* Lesson storyline banner */
  .fg-storyline {
    border-left: 5px solid var(--aaic-valley); background: #f2f8f7;
    border-radius: 0 8px 8px 0; padding: 0.75rem 1rem;
  }
  .fg-storyline p:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }

  /* Definition boxes */
  .fg-defbox { border: 1px solid var(--aaic-border); border-radius: 8px; overflow: hidden; margin-bottom: 0.75rem; }
  .fg-defbox .fg-defbox-label {
    background: var(--aaic-globe); color: #fff; padding: 0.3rem 0.75rem;
    font-family: var(--fg-heading-font); font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.8rem;
  }
  .fg-defbox.fg-defbox-student .fg-defbox-label { background: var(--aaic-valley); }
  .fg-defbox .fg-defbox-label p { margin: 0; }
  .fg-defbox .fg-defbox-body { padding: 0.6rem 0.75rem; }
  .fg-defbox .fg-defbox-body p:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }

  /* Why / How two-column box */
  .fg-whyhow { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 0.75rem; }
  .fg-whyhow > div { border-radius: 8px; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; }
  .fg-whyhow .fg-why { background: var(--aaic-ltblue); border-top: 4px solid var(--aaic-globe); }
  .fg-whyhow .fg-how { background: var(--aaic-ltorange); border-top: 4px solid var(--aaic-torch); }
  .fg-whyhow h5 { font-size: 0.9rem; margin: 0 0 0.35rem; }
  .fg-whyhow p:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }
  @media (max-width: 640px) { .fg-whyhow { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }

  /* CK / PCK call-outs */
  .fg-callout { border-radius: 8px; padding: 0.6rem 1rem; margin-bottom: 0.6rem; border-left: 5px solid; }
  .fg-callout p:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }
  .fg-callout-ck  { border-color: var(--aaic-globe); background: var(--aaic-ltblue); }
  .fg-callout-pck { border-color: var(--aaic-torch); background: var(--aaic-ltorange); }
  .fg-callout .fg-tag { margin-right: 0.4rem; }

  /* Practice overview page + reminder icon */
  .fg-overview { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); gap: 0.6rem; margin-bottom: 0.75rem; }
  .fg-overview > div { border: 1px solid var(--aaic-border); border-radius: 8px; padding: 0.6rem 0.75rem; font-size: 0.9rem; }
  .fg-overview h5 { font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--aaic-globe); margin: 0 0 0.25rem; }
  .fg-overview p:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }
  @media (max-width: 640px) { .fg-overview { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }
  .fg-reminder-row { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 0.75rem; }
  .fg-reminder {
    flex: 0 0 auto; width: 6.5rem; text-align: center; border: 2px solid var(--aaic-globe);
    border-radius: 8px; padding: 0.3rem 0.2rem; font-size: 0.65rem; font-weight: 700;
    color: var(--aaic-globe); line-height: 1.2; text-transform: uppercase;
  }
  .fg-reminder .fg-reminder-icon { display: block; font-size: 1.4rem; line-height: 1.2; }
  .fg-reminder-step { flex: 1; }
  .fg-reminder-step strong { color: var(--aaic-globe); }
  .fg-reminder-step .fg-cite { display: block; white-space: normal; margin-top: 0.25rem; }

  /* Narrative vignette */
  .fg-narrative {
    position: relative; background: #faf8f4; border: 1px solid var(--aaic-limestone);
    border-radius: 8px; padding: 1rem 1rem 0.75rem 3.25rem;
  }
  .fg-narrative::before {
    content: "\201C"; position: absolute; left: 0.85rem; top: 0.1rem;
    font-family: Georgia, serif; font-size: 3rem; color: var(--aaic-torch); line-height: 1;
  }
  .fg-narrative p:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }
  .fg-dialogue { margin: 0.5rem 0 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; font-size: 0.9rem; }
  .fg-dialogue li { margin-bottom: 0.25rem; }
  .fg-dialogue .fg-speaker { font-weight: 700; color: var(--aaic-globe); margin-right: 0.35rem; }

  /* Sample student work */
  .fg-work { border: 1px solid var(--aaic-border); border-radius: 8px; overflow: hidden; margin-top: 1rem; }
  .fg-work .fg-work-label {
    background: var(--aaic-limestone); color: var(--aaic-smokey); padding: 0.35rem 1rem;
    font-family: var(--fg-heading-font); font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.8rem;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--aaic-border);
  }
  .fg-work .fg-work-label p { margin: 0; }
  .fg-work .fg-work-sample { padding: 0.75rem 1rem; }
  .fg-work .fg-work-sample .fg-work-prompt { color: var(--aaic-smokey); font-size: 0.9rem; }
  .fg-work .fg-work-sample .fg-work-response {
    border-left: 3px solid var(--aaic-border); padding-left: 0.85rem; margin-top: 0.5rem;
  }
  .fg-work .fg-work-feedback { border-top: 1px dashed var(--aaic-border); padding: 0.6rem 1rem; background: var(--aaic-ltorange); font-size: 0.9rem; }
  .fg-work p:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }

  /* Capstone question */
  .fg-capstone {
    border: 2px solid var(--aaic-globe); border-radius: var(--fg-radius);
    padding: 1rem 1.25rem; text-align: center;
  }
  .fg-capstone .fg-capstone-q { font-family: var(--fg-heading-font); font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.1rem; color: var(--aaic-globe); }
  .fg-capstone p:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }

  .fg-ef-refs { font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--aaic-smokey); }
  .fg-ef-refs p { padding-left: 1.5rem; text-indent: -1.5rem; }

  .fg-ef-hint { font-size: 0.9rem; color: var(--aaic-smokey); font-style: italic; margin: 0 0 0.75rem; }


  /* ---------- Simplified blocks (no nesting needed) ---------- */
  .fg-grid-2, .fg-grid-3, .fg-grid-4 { display: grid; gap: 1rem; margin: 1rem 0 1.5rem; }
  .fg-grid-2 { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); }
  .fg-grid-3 { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); }
  .fg-grid-4 { grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); }
  @media (max-width: 767px) {
    .fg-grid-2, .fg-grid-3 { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    .fg-grid-4 { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); }
  }
  .fg-hero + .fg-grid-4 { margin-bottom: 2rem; }
  .fg-card { background: #fff; padding: 1rem 1.25rem; display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
  .fg-card > p:last-child { margin-top: auto; margin-bottom: 0; }
  .fg-card > ul:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }
  .fg-card > p:first-child { margin-bottom: 0.25rem; }
  .fg-card, .fg-stat { overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
  .fg-stat { padding: 1rem 0.75rem; }
  .fg-stat p { margin-bottom: 0.25rem; }
  .fg-card-title {
    display: block; font-family: var(--fg-heading-font); font-weight: 700;
    font-size: 1.1rem; color: var(--aaic-globe);
  }
  .fg-card-header {
    display: block; margin: -1rem -1.25rem 0.5rem; padding: 0.6rem 1.25rem;
    background: var(--aaic-ltblue); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--aaic-border);
    border-radius: var(--fg-radius) var(--fg-radius) 0 0;
    font-family: var(--fg-heading-font); font-weight: 700; color: var(--aaic-globe);
  }
  .fg-edge-globe, .fg-edge-valley, .fg-edge-torch, .fg-edge-river {
    border-left: 5px solid var(--fg-edge-color) !important;
  }

  .fg-linklist ul { list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 0; }
  .fg-linklist li {
    display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;
    gap: 0.15rem 0.5rem; padding: 0.5rem 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--aaic-border);
  }
  .fg-linklist li:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
  .fg-linklist li a { font-weight: 600; }
  .fg-link-note { flex-basis: 100%; font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--aaic-smokey); }

  .fg-accordion { margin: 1rem 0 1.5rem; }
  .fg-steps { counter-reset: fgstep; }
  .fg-step { counter-increment: fgstep; }
  .fg-checklist ul { list-style: none; padding-left: 0; margin: 0; }
  .fg-checklist li { margin: 0.15rem 0; }
  .fg-checklist input { margin-right: 0.5rem; }

  .fg-timeline > .fg-segment {
    display: grid; grid-template-columns: 5.5rem 1fr; gap: 1rem;
    padding: 0.75rem 0; border-bottom: 1px dashed var(--aaic-border);
  }
  .fg-timeline > .fg-segment:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
  .fg-segment-body p { margin: 0; }
  .fg-segment-body strong:first-child { display: block; font-family: var(--fg-heading-font); margin-bottom: 0.15rem; }

  .fg-carousel .fg-caption p { margin: 0; }
  .fg-slide-num {
    display: block; font-size: 0.75rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em;
    color: var(--aaic-smokey); margin-bottom: 0.25rem;
  }

  .fg-flow .fg-flow-step { position: relative; }
  .fg-flow .fg-flow-step p { margin: 0; }
  .fg-flow .fg-flow-step:not(:last-child)::after {
    content: "→"; position: absolute; right: -1.45rem; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%);
    color: var(--aaic-globe); font-size: 1.25rem;
  }
  @media (max-width: 640px) {
    .fg-flow .fg-flow-step:not(:last-child)::after {
      content: "↓"; right: auto; left: 50%; top: auto; bottom: -1.75rem; transform: translateX(-50%);
    }
  }

  .fg-reminder p, .fg-reminder-step p { margin: 0; }
  .fg-dialogue ul { list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 0; }
  .fg-dialogue li { margin-bottom: 0.25rem; }
  .fg-dialogue strong { color: var(--aaic-globe); }

  .fg-defbox > p:first-child, .fg-work > p:first-child { margin: 0; }
  .fg-defbox .fg-defbox-label, .fg-work .fg-work-label { display: block; }
  .fg-work .fg-work-sample .fg-work-prompt { display: block; }
  .fg-whyhow-title {
    display: block; font-family: var(--fg-heading-font); font-weight: 700;
    font-size: 0.9rem; margin-bottom: 0.35rem;
  }
  .fg-overview-title {
    display: block; font-family: var(--fg-heading-font); font-weight: 700;
    font-size: 1.1rem; margin: 0.25rem 0 0.5rem;
  }
  .fg-overview-label {
    display: block; font-family: var(--fg-heading-font); font-weight: 700;
    font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--aaic-globe); margin-bottom: 0.25rem;
  }
  .fg-overview p { margin-bottom: 0.25rem; }


  /* Learning objectives: subject tags */
  .fg-tag-ct        { background: var(--aaic-globe); }
  .fg-tag-ds        { background: var(--aaic-valley); }
  .fg-tag-math      { background: var(--aaic-torch); }
  .fg-tag-science   { background: var(--aaic-river); }
  .fg-tag-agscience { background: #ABC178; color: #2f3a12; }  /* Switchgrass */
  .fg-objectives > ul { margin: 0.75rem 0 1.5rem; padding-left: 1.25rem; }
  .fg-objectives > ul > li { margin-bottom: 0.4rem; }
  .fg-objectives .fg-tag { min-width: 5.25rem; text-align: center; margin-right: 0.35rem; }
  .fg-objectives ul ul { margin-top: 0.25rem; }


  /* Educative features pasted into the page */
  .fg-feature { margin: 1rem 0 1.25rem; }
  .fg-feature-label {
    display: block; font-family: var(--fg-heading-font); font-weight: 700;
    font-size: 0.8rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em;
    color: var(--aaic-globe); border-bottom: 2px solid var(--aaic-summit);
    padding-bottom: 0.25rem; margin-bottom: 0.6rem;
  }
  .fg-feature > p:first-child { margin-bottom: 0; }
  .fg-callout, .fg-whyhow, .fg-defbox, .fg-capstone, .fg-reminder-row { margin-top: 0.75rem; margin-bottom: 0.75rem; }

  /* Print: expand collapsed content, hide interactive chrome */
  @media print {
    .collapse { display: block !important; height: auto !important; }
    .carousel-item { display: block !important; float: none !important; }
    .carousel-control-prev, .carousel-control-next, .carousel-indicators, .fg-btn, .fg-btn-outline { display: none !important; }
    .fg-hero { color: #000; background: none; border: 2px solid var(--aaic-globe); }
  }
</style>
<script>
/* Turns the simple blocks in the content above into interactive parts:
   expandable panels, the timeline and the prep checklist. */
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
  const attr = (el, name) => el.getAttribute("data-" + name) ?? el.getAttribute(name);

  // Expandable panels (.fg-accordion > .fg-panel)
  document.querySelectorAll(".fg-accordion").forEach((acc, a) => {
    acc.id = acc.id || `fg-accordion-${a + 1}`;
    acc.classList.add("accordion");
    acc.querySelectorAll(":scope > .fg-panel").forEach((panel, i) => {
      const id = `${acc.id}-panel-${i + 1}`;
      const open = attr(panel, "open") === "true";
      const item = document.createElement("div");
      item.className = "accordion-item";
      const header = document.createElement("h3");
      header.className = "accordion-header";
      const button = document.createElement("button");
      button.className = "accordion-button" + (open ? "" : " collapsed");
      button.type = "button";
      button.setAttribute("data-bs-toggle", "collapse");
      button.setAttribute("data-bs-target", "#" + id);
      button.setAttribute("aria-expanded", String(open));
      button.setAttribute("aria-controls", id);
      button.textContent = attr(panel, "label") || "Untitled panel";
      header.appendChild(button);
      const collapse = document.createElement("div");
      collapse.id = id;
      collapse.className = "accordion-collapse collapse" + (open ? " show" : "");
      collapse.setAttribute("data-bs-parent", "#" + acc.id);
      const body = document.createElement("div");
      body.className = "accordion-body";
      body.append(...panel.childNodes);
      collapse.appendChild(body);
      item.append(header, collapse);
      panel.replaceWith(item);
    });
  });

  // Timeline (.fg-timeline > .fg-segment)
  const groupColors = {
    "whole class": "globe", "direct instruction": "river",
    "groups": "valley", "coding": "torch", "individual": ""
  };
  document.querySelectorAll(".fg-timeline > .fg-segment").forEach((seg) => {
    const time = document.createElement("div");
    time.className = "fg-time";
    time.textContent = attr(seg, "time") || "";
    const length = attr(seg, "length");
    if (length) {
      const small = document.createElement("small");
      small.textContent = length;
      time.appendChild(small);
    }
    const body = document.createElement("div");
    body.className = "fg-segment-body";
    body.append(...seg.childNodes);
    const group = attr(seg, "group");
    if (group) {
      const tag = document.createElement("span");
      const color = groupColors[group.trim().toLowerCase()];
      tag.className = "fg-tag" + (color ? " fg-tag-" + color : "");
      tag.textContent = group;
      const target = body.querySelector(":scope > p") || body;
      target.append(" ", tag);
    }
    seg.replaceChildren(time, body);
  });

  // Prep checklist built from the step titles (.fg-checklist)
  document.querySelectorAll(".fg-checklist").forEach((list) => {
    const steps = [...document.querySelectorAll(".fg-steps .fg-step")];
    if (!steps.length) return;
    const ul = document.createElement("ul");
    steps.forEach((step, i) => {
      step.id = step.id || `prep-step-${i + 1}`;
      const title = step.querySelector("h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6");
      const li = document.createElement("li");
      const label = document.createElement("label");
      const box = document.createElement("input");
      box.type = "checkbox";
      const link = document.createElement("a");
      link.href = "#" + step.id;
      link.textContent = `Step ${i + 1}: ${title ? title.textContent.trim() : ""}`;
      label.append(box, link);
      li.appendChild(label);
      ul.appendChild(li);
    });
    list.replaceChildren(ul);
  });
});
</script>
```
